## Publication gate

The Horror family passes only when:

- all four Monster sources expose a distinct Horror Graft;
- each reveal is bounded, telegraphed, and answerable without damage;
- canonical Bestiary names are preserved when the mechanic is recognizably canonical;
- Horror does not duplicate Body anatomy, Mind behavior, Attack routine, or Twist escalation;
- all CR projections compile with verified renderer parity;
- no vague permanent aging or campaign harm remains in the public rules.
